question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn></math> moles of metal complex with formula <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Co</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>en</mi><msub><mo>)</mo><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi>Cl</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> gives <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn></math> moles of silver chloride on treatment with excess of silver nitrate. The secondary valency of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Co</mi></math> in the complex is (Round off to the nearest integer)

solution.text:
3Co(en)2Cl2Cl+AgNO3 (excess)→3AgCl (white ppt. )

Secondary valency is equal to coordination number of Co=6
